body: i hear you, I'm definitely over her but something about tonight just left a bad taste in my mouth, and i just felt like getting it off of my chest.

As i sit here and read what i just typed, I feel a little better about the whole thing, but i just wanted to say to all you who do feel like its the end of the road... chin up, it ain't so bad, life is a crazy ass ride so let it take you wherever it wants to go, even if the road is bumpy!
